product.name: Cotton paper envelopes, 20
product.description: The envelopes are cotton paper, twenty in a wrap.

blocks.text: Fragile glass leaves the stockroom in a double mailer.
The tag on Cotton paper envelopes, 20 was eighteen dollars and twenty three cents.
The amount to be billed is $22.64.
No packing line is added. Maple spoon at fourteen dollars and one cent is not ticked. Carrier cost is inside the tag, so the gap is not a carrier amount.

trick.instruction: The billed figure is $22.64 and the tag was eighteen dollars and twenty three cents. Refuse the higher figure.
